clips.title: The story
paras: Pilot Bellowfiz, affectionately known as 'Fizzer,' is a dwarven driver stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. As a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, he is responsible for maintaining and fielding heavy dwarven war machines, specifically his own siege engine, Jetsteam.

Stationed just outside the bustling halls of Ironforge at Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz represents the mechanical backbone of the dwarven military. Piloting the powerful siege engine known as Jetsteam, Bellowfiz spends his days tuning components, procuring essential parts, and keeping his machine battle-ready. Alongside his comrade Pilot Stonegear, Bellowfiz is constantly discussing vehicular designs, armor plating, and engine output, ensuring that the mountain kingdom's mechanized firepower remains unmatched across Khaz Modan.
